import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def pump_failure(f):
    "Tank level rises above start_level_pct while pump is stopped, sustained or rapid rise."
    pump_stopped = f.pump_status == 0
    level = f.tank_level_pct.where(pump_stopped)
    start = f.start_level_pct.iloc[0]  # constant per facility
    
    # Condition 1: level > start_level_pct for >=3 consecutive readings (15 min)
    above_start = (level > start).astype(int)
    consecutive = above_start.groupby((above_start == 0).cumsum()).cumsum()
    cond1 = consecutive >= 3
    
    # Condition 2: 30-min window (6 readings) increase >5 pct points while pump stopped
    level_diff = level.diff(6)  # change over 6 periods (30 min)
    cond2 = level_diff > 5
    
    return (cond1 | cond2).where(pump_stopped)

def pipeline_leak(f):
    "Pipeline pressure stays below 1044.40 psi for a full hour while pump runs."
    pump_running = f.pump_status == 1
    pressure = f.pipeline_pressure_psi.where(pump_running)
    
    # Pressure below threshold for 12 consecutive readings (1 hour)
    below_thresh = (pressure < 1044.40).astype(int)
    consecutive = below_thresh.groupby((below_thresh == 0).cumsum()).cumsum()
    
    return (consecutive >= 12).where(pump_running)

def pump_degradation(f):
    "Pump flow declines >0.5%/hour over a 2-hour window while pump runs."
    pump_running = f.pump_status == 1
    flow = f.pump_flow_bpd.where(pump_running)
    max_flow = f.max_flow_bpd.iloc[0]  # constant per facility
    
    # Normalized flow ratio
    ratio = flow / max_flow
    
    # 2-hour decline rate: (flow_now - flow_2h_ago) / (2h * flow_2h_ago)  [per hour]
    # 24 periods = 2 hours at 5-min intervals
    flow_2h_ago = flow.shift(24)
    decline_rate_per_hour = (flow - flow_2h_ago) / (2 * flow_2h_ago)
    
    # Decline >0.5%/hour = rate < -0.005
    # Also require flow already >5% below max (ratio < 0.95) to avoid noise at full capacity
    cond = (decline_rate_per_hour < -0.005) & (ratio < 0.95)
    
    return cond.where(pump_running)
